description: Pull a rulemaking docket from Regulations.gov by docket ID (e.g. "EPA-HQ-OAR-2025-0194") — the docket's metadata (title, agency, RIN, abstract) and the documents filed in it (NPRM, final rule, supporting materials) — or read one document by document_id for its file download URLs and attachments, which a docket listing does not carry. Provide exactly one of docket_id / document_id. The docket is the folder holding a rule's whole paper trail; each returned document's objectId feeds regulations_find_comments. A docket often contains hundreds of supporting materials — find one with search_term, or filter document_types to "Proposed Rule"/"Rule" for the rule documents themselves. Requires REGULATIONS_GOV_API_KEY (free at https://api.data.gov/signup/); the Federal Register and eCFR tools work without it.

docket_id.description: List mode: Regulations.gov docket ID (e.g. "EPA-HQ-OAR-2025-0194"). Obtain from regulationsGovDocketId on a regulations_search_rules or regulations_list_open_comments row, or docketId from regulations_get_document. The printed docketIds on those tools are not always Regulations.gov IDs ("REG-101355-26" is the IRS's own number for docket IRS-2026-0925). Exactly one of docket_id / document_id.

document_id.description: Detail mode: one document by Regulations.gov document ID (e.g. "EPA-HQ-OW-2022-0114-3084") — documentId from a docket listing, or regulationsGovDocumentId from regulations_get_document. Returns its download URLs and attachments. Pass it alone, without docket_id or the list filters.

document_types.description: List mode: filter the docket's documents to these types. Omit for all. A docket often contains hundreds of "Supporting & Related Material" items — filter to "Proposed Rule"/"Rule" to find the rule documents.

page.description: Page number (1–40, default 1). Regulations.gov serves 40 pages, so a docket listing reaches 40 × per_page documents (10,000 at per_page 250); totalPages and nextPage in the response say how far this one goes. Beyond that, narrow with search_term or document_types.

per_page.description: Documents per page (at least 5, default 25, capped at 250 with a notice). Regulations.gov requires a minimum page size of 5.

search_term.description: List mode: keep only the docket's documents whose text matches, as Regulations.gov full-text search reads it, ranked by relevance instead of newest first. Combines with document_types.

name: regulations_get_docket

cap.description: The most documents 40 pages reach at this per_page (40 × per_page); set with truncated.

document.description: One document with its download URLs and attachments (detail mode).

attachments.description: Attachments in upload order, withheld ones included.

items.description: One attachment with its available formats.

formats.description: Available file formats for the attachment; empty when the file is withheld.

size.description: File size in bytes, or null.

restrictReasonType.description: Why the file is withheld (e.g. "Copyrighted"), or null when Regulations.gov gives no reason.

docketId.description: Docket the document is filed in, or null.

documentType.description: Document type (e.g. "Supporting & Related Material"), or null.

fileFormats.description: The document's main file in each format; empty when it has none — the content may then be in its attachments.

size.description: File size in bytes, or null.

frDocNum.description: Federal Register document number — chains back into regulations_get_document. Null when absent.

objectId.description: Document object ID — chains into regulations_find_comments(document_object_id). Null when absent.

pageCount.description: Pages in the document, or null when Regulations.gov counts none.

restrictReasonType.description: Why the document's content is withheld (e.g. "Copyrighted"), or null.

withdrawn.description: True when the document was withdrawn; null when Regulations.gov does not say.

documentCount.description: Documents in the docket matching search_term and document_types, before pagination (list mode).

documents.description: Documents filed in the docket (this page; list mode). Download URLs require document_id detail mode.

items.description: One document filed in the docket.

commentEndDate.description: The UTC instant the comment period ends, or null. Periods end at 11:59 PM Eastern, so "2023-05-31T03:59:59Z" is the close date 2023-05-30 the Federal Register prints.

commentPeriodOpen.description: Whether the document is open for comment now, as Regulations.gov reports it (its openForComment); null when Regulations.gov doesn't say.

frDocNum.description: Federal Register document number — chains back into regulations_get_document. Null when absent.

withdrawn.description: True when the document was withdrawn.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `auth_required`: REGULATIONS_GOV_API_KEY is not configured, or Regulations.gov rejected the key that is. `target_required`: Neither docket_id nor document_id was given. `multiple_targets`: Both docket_id and document_id were given. `filter_requires_list_mode`: search_term or document_types was given with document_id, which reads one document and takes no filters. `not_found`: No docket exists with that docket_id, or no document with that document_id. `rate_limited`: Regulations.gov returned 429 (1,000 requests/hour per key). `upstream_unavailable`: Regulations.gov returned a 5xx, timed out, or could not be reached at all. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mode.description: Which mode produced this result: list (docket_id) or detail (document_id).

nextPage.description: Page to request next — present only when a later page holds documents.

notice.description: Guidance when per_page was above its ceiling, no documents matched, the page is past the end, documents lie beyond the last page, or a document has no main file.

objectId.description: Docket object ID, or null (list mode).

rin.description: Regulation Identifier Number ("Not Assigned" when none), or null (list mode).

totalPages.description: Pages of documents at this per_page, at most the 40 Regulations.gov serves; 0 when there are none (list mode).

truncated.description: True when the docket holds more documents than 40 pages reach at this per_page, so some are on no page — set on every page of such a docket.

title: regulations_get_docket
